summary.en: Disruptive AI is a Herzliya-based venture capital firm that brands itself as Israel's first AI-focused VC, leading early-stage investments in AI startups across applications such as transcription (Verbit), fraud prevention (nSure.ai) and food tech (Tastewise). Founded and led by Tal Barnoach with partners including Yorai Fainmesser and Gadi Tirosh; it has made 17 investments with an exit in Staircase AI (acquired 2024).

summary.en: Random Forest VC is a Tel Aviv-based boutique early-stage fund founded in 2018 that invests exclusively in market-disruptive ventures built on machine learning and AI. It evaluates startups on 'Product-Market-Data' fit and supports portfolio founders with in-house data scholars over a 6-month program. It has made about 13 investments including qbiq, FeelBetter and Ototo.

strategy.thesis: Early-stage fund backing founders at the forefront of the AI revolution across infrastructure, agents and applications in the AI-powered digital economy — spanning gaming, media, fintech operations and next-gen consumer tech.

summary.en: Remagine Ventures is an early-stage (pre-seed/seed) fund based in Tel Aviv and London, founded in 2018 by Eze Vidra and Kevin Baxpehler. It invests in founders at the forefront of the AI revolution — AI infrastructure, agents and applications across gaming, media, fintech operations and consumer tech. It raised a $35M first fund and a $25M second fund ($60M total), with portfolio companies including Hour One, Troup AI and Keewano.

strategy.thesis: Seed-stage fund focused exclusively on Vertical AI — industry-specific AI solutions embedded in core business processes across finance, healthcare and manufacturing — targeting capital-efficient companies and faster, mid-sized exits.

summary.en: FutureFirst is a seed-stage venture fund launched in February 2026 by Hila Rom and Tammy Mahn, targeting $50 million (about half committed at launch) to invest exclusively in Vertical AI — industry-specific AI solutions for finance, healthcare and manufacturing. It writes roughly $1.5M checks and is structured for capital-efficient, faster mid-sized exits, operating in partnership with Brooks-Keret across Israel and the US.

summary.en: AlphaDrive Ventures is a $100 million Tel Aviv-based fund launched in May 2026 by Yaron Elad and Elik Etzion (both ex-Elron Ventures), investing at the convergence of AI and cybersecurity. summary.en: WorldQuant Genesis is the Israeli deep-tech venture arm of quant billionaire Igor Tulchinsky's WorldQuant, led by former IDF Northern Corps commander Saar Tzur. It targets early-stage research companies combining AI, robotics and biotechnology, investing up to $1M per company in roughly two to three companies per year. Its first disclosed investment was Israeli defense-tech startup Navairo.
